postings.title: Solutions Engineer
postings.description:
At Gigaton, we’re on a mission to cut gigatonnes of carbon emissions from the world’s biggest emitting industries (like cement, steel and glass), by building autonomous AI control and optimisation systems that learn and leverage the physics of manufacturing. Our products run heavy industrial plants more efficiently, more stably, and with lower emissions in real time - laying the foundation for the next industrial revolution.

We are a team of scientists, engineers, builders, and operators who love hard problems, have high standards, and want to make change happen in the physical world. We care about deep tech, but we care even more about whether it delivers cost and carbon impact in a live plant, with real people, under real constraints.

With Gigaton, you’ll solve really tough problems in places few people ever get close to, and build something that actually helps the planet. Are you up for the challenge?


ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re seeking a Solutions Engineer to join our Solutions Engineering team and sit on the frontline of industrial decarbonisation.

This role blends industrial process expertise, control engineering, and deployment leadership. You’ll work directly with plant management, process engineers and operators to understand complex chemical processes, design optimal AI control strategies, and integrate Gigaton’s AI into live production environments. Your mission is to ensure that we delight our customers by using our AI solutions to solve critical operational problems and deliver real, measurable cost and carbon impact.



YOUR MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Build trust and engagement with plant managers, process engineers and operators by clearly explaining technical decisions and demonstrating measurable benefits aligned to operational needs.

 - Analyse plant data to assess and identify opportunities, and evaluate the performance of Gigaton’s software.

 - Develop and refine control strategies, leveraging APC, MPC, and PID principles.

 - Deploy and integrate Gigaton AI into live plants, ensuring stable, safe, and effective operation.

 - Collaborate with plant and process teams to identify optimisation opportunities, tune control loops, and validate performance improvements.

 - Collaborate with machine learning engineers to refine algorithms and recommendations based on real-world outcomes.

 - Create and refine deployment playbooks and templates, ensuring repeatable, scalable, and high-quality rollouts across plants.

 - Act as a feedback loop into Gigaton’s product and machine learning teams, providing field insights that shape our product roadmap.

 - Travel to sites (~1 week/month) to work hands-on with teams during commissioning, testing, and optimisation phases.


WHAT A GREAT FIT LOOKS LIKE

 - Strong process or control engineering background, ideally in cement, chemicals, energy or heavy manufacturing.

 - Comfortable collaborating with operators, plant managers, engineers, and data scientists, bridging industrial know-how with data-driven insights.

 - Strong analytical skills and outcome-oriented mindset, able to dig into industrial data, identify root causes, generate actionable solutions, and deliver them.

 - Excellent communication skills, able to build credibility and trust in complex industrial environments.

 - Excellent project management skills, with the ability to work independently, drive clear actions for yourself, your team and the customer, deliver against the plan, and manage project risks.

 - Practical problem-solver who enjoys working on real-world process challenges.

 - Willingness to travel: regularly to deployment sites (~25%).


YOU’LL EXCEL IF

 - You thrive in dynamic, high-impact environments. Fast-paced, ambiguous settings energise you, and you’re motivated by work where every deployment contributes directly to decarbonisation.

 - You take ownership and thrive when you’re given full responsibility for projects and can see them through end-to-end. You spot problems and act decisively to solve them.

 - You have experience with industrial control (APC/MPC/PID), automation (DCS, PLC) or data (OPC, Historian, LIMS) systems.

 - You have an understanding of AI/ML applications, such as forecasting, optimisation, anomaly detection.

 - You have implemented or tuned control systems and understand how to balance process stability, quality, and energy efficiency.

 - You are confident working across technical, operational and business interfaces, turning complex problems into structured solutions and communicating complex ideas to multiple audiences.


SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE MEANS

 - Plants achieve measurable performance improvements — lower costs, reduced CO₂, improved stability.

 - Customer process engineers trust you as a reliable partner who understands their world.

 - Deployments become more repeatable, efficient, and scalable thanks to your control and process insights.

 - Your field insights help Gigaton’s solutions evolve into robust, operator-friendly process control systems.

 - 💡 You are not expected to check every box, and we’d love to hear from you even if your experience isn’t an exact match.
   
   We’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change. Our people come from all walks of life, with different countries, cultures, and experiences, and we think that’s one of our biggest strengths.
   
   We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels safe, respected, and celebrated. No matter your background, if you’re excited by what we do, we want to hear from you.




THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

 1. Talent Partner Screen Call: Meet our talent partner and learn more about Gigaton and the role.

 2. Hiring Manager Screen: Meet our Lead Solutions Engineer, usually alongside another member of the Solutions Engineering team, to discuss your experience and whether the role could be a good fit.

 3. Technical Interviews:
    
    1. Cement Process Optimisation 
       
       1. The Task: Work through a kiln optimisation scenario, balancing process stability, clinker quality, fuel use, and emissions to recommend an operating and control strategy.
       
       2. What it’s assessing: Ability to reason about complex plant dynamics, weigh competing trade-offs, and connect process decisions to overall plant performance and cost impact.
    
    2. Delivery Management
       
       1. The Task: Talk through real examples from your career of owning complex industrial software projects end‑to‑end, plus problem solving examples and experience working with software teams. You'll then apply that experience to a live Gigaton scenario.
       
       2. What it's assessing: End‑to‑end delivery and accountability, stakeholder management and communication. Ability to problem‑solve individually and with a team in real industrial and customer environments; ability to work effectively with software engineering teams, as well as speed of learning in new domains.

 4. Operating Principles Interview: Understand how we work and whether Gigaton and you are a good fit for each other.

 5. Meet with the CEO: Every new potential hire meets Josh.

We believe hiring is a two-way process. Just as we’ll reference-check candidates before making a final offer, we encourage you to reference-check us by chatting to team members you haven’t yet met. Ask anything. We’ll answer with Concrete Honesty.

Once interviews are done, we’ll move quickly to a decision, and we’re always happy to give feedback at any stage.

In return for your hard work, we’ll give you

📈 Equity in the company: When we win, you win. You’ll get share options, so you’re part of our journey from the inside.

🕰️ Flexible working We trust you to know how and when you work best and to work that out with your team.

🌴 30 days of holiday (plus bank holidays). Rest is productive. Take the time you need to recharge

🪙 A generous pension scheme. We’re planning for the future in more ways than one.

Our Operating Principles 


↗️ Go Gig or Go Home: High Bar, All In. What we do matters to humanity, to our customers and to each other. We hold ourselves to an extraordinarily high bar and bring the urgency this mission requires.

🏭 Concrete Honesty: Be honest. As concrete forms the foundation of our world, genuine honesty and transparency are the bedrock of our culture.

🦾 Autonomous Ownership: High agency, high ownership. We build systems that take control and make things better. We do the same: see it, own it, drive it.

😄 Cement it with Kindness & Fun: Have fun, be kind. We're here to extend Earth's life, but ours is still limited. We want to enjoy the ride. To see these in full, go to Gigaton’s Operating Principles https://gigaton-technologies.notion.site/gigaton-s-operating-principles Notion page.

Analytical skills will be essential to delve deep into complex plant data and work out how Gigaton's AI products can solve their most critical issues.

Building on that, you'll need strategic thinking and commercial awareness to turn your findings into concise, compelling proposals for decision-makers at our customers, from the C-suite down.

Ultimately, you'll build clarity from uncertainty, making sure we agree a shared roadmap with our customers that puts our solutions on track for significant real-world benefits before a contract is signed.

Over time, you’ll help us evolve our sales approach and shape the product by feeding insights and needs from the plant back to the product team, building the foundation for scaling across industries.

 - Lead technical discovery and identify early when a plant does not meet our ICP (ideal customer profile) criteria.

 - Make sure relationships and plant understanding are handed over successfully to the deployment team.

 - Act as a feedback loop into Gigaton’s product and machine learning teams, providing field insights that help shape our product roadmap.

 - Develop and iterate the pre-sales technical process, making it more impactful and more automated each time.

 - Travel to plants and conferences, around one week per month, to understand customer environments and explain the product.


WHAT A GREAT FIT LOOKS LIKE

 - Exposure to physical sciences, controls, or heavy industry, such as cement, steel, energy, manufacturing, or similar.

 - Strong analytical skills and an outcome-oriented mindset. You can dig into industrial data, identify root causes, generate potential solutions, and explain their value in dollars and tonnes of CO2.

 - Excellent communication skills. You can build credibility and trust in complex industrial environments with both engineers and board-level stakeholders.

 - Comfortable being the technical voice in the conversation, presenting to senior plant leaders and operators, handling objections, and being challenged on your findings by people who have run kilns for 30 years.

 - Naturally curious and keen to learn about the industry, the technology, and each individual plant. You want to understand the root cause behind every question and objection so you can solve the right problem.

 - Confident in ambiguity and able to field very specific technical questions without getting flustered. You know when you can give your understanding, when you need to go and find the answer, and how to maintain customer confidence in both situations.

 - Willingness to travel regularly.


YOU’LL EXCEL IF

 - You build trust easily. You can connect with plant engineers, listen deeply, and align solutions to their priorities.

 - You’d rather diagnose than pitch. Your first instinct in a plant is to ask a better question, not to open the deck.

 - You thrive in dynamic environments. Fast-paced, ambiguous settings excite you, and you’re motivated by high-impact, mission-driven work.

 - You have experience working in heavy industry, particularly cement, steel, energy, heavy manufacturing, or similar.

postings.title: Senior Software Engineer
postings.description:

With Gigaton, you’ll solve really tough problems in places few people ever get close to, and build something that actually helps the planet. Are you up for the challenge?


ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Platform team and help us build reliable software for a complex, real-world AI product.

The Platform team works across a broad range of problems at Gigaton, from CI/CD for our monorepo and networking and data integration with on-premise plant systems, to hardening our IoT OS image and building customer-facing software around our control systems.

The work is currently split across two squads:

 1. Enablement, focused on helping engineers move faster.

 2. Product, focused on supporting our control software.

Whichever squad you join, you’ll work across technically challenging problems with plenty of scope to learn, contribute and shape how we build software.



YOUR MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Write reliable, well-tested software in Python and Terraform.

 - Monitor, support and improve software running in production.

 - Mentor less experienced engineers and help them develop their craft.

 - Identify, articulate and drive architectural improvements.

 - Bring strong software engineering practices to code developed across the wider engineering and ML teams.

 - Contribute to improving the quality, maintainability and reliability of our systems.


BONUS EXPERIENCE

You don’t need all of these, but experience in any of the following would be useful:

 - Control engineering, machine learning or MLOps.

 - AWS IoT, Greengrass or Mender for managing device fleets.

 - Working across multiple cloud environments, such as AWS, GCP or Azure.

 - Managing CI/CD environments using GitHub Actions.

 - Building production artefacts using tools such as Docker.

 - Functional programming languages such as Haskell, F# or Elm.

 - Building or working with more complex AI-enabled workflows beyond simple prompting.


YOU’LL EXCEL IF YOU ARE

 - Excited by complex technical domains and enjoy getting to grips with unfamiliar systems.

 - Highly collaborative and comfortable working across software, ML and other disciplines.

 - Familiar with practices such as testing, pairing, mobbing and iterative software development.

 - Pragmatic about engineering trade-offs and know when good enough now is better than perfect later.

 - Comfortable working with ambiguity and evolving requirements.

 - Able to improve existing systems, not just build new ones from scratch.

 - Happy to take ownership of problems and follow them through into production.

💡 You are not expected to check every box, and we’d love to hear from you even if your experience isn’t an exact match.

We’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change. Our people come from different countries, cultures and experiences, and we think that’s one of our biggest strengths.

We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels safe, respected and celebrated. No matter your background, if you’re excited by what we do, we want to hear from you.



THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

Our interview process is designed to help us understand your experience, how you think and how you work with others, while giving you plenty of opportunity to get to know Gigaton too.


1. TALENT PARTNER CONVERSATION

You’ll start with a conversation with our Talent Partner. We’ll talk through your background, what you’re looking for and what interests you about Gigaton.

We’ll also give you more context on the role, the team and the interview process, and answer any initial questions you have.


2. HIRING MANAGER INTERVIEW

Next, you’ll meet the hiring manager for a deeper conversation about your experience and some of the technical problems you’ve worked on.

We’ll explore the work you’ve owned, the decisions you’ve made, how you approach engineering trade-offs and whether the role feels like a strong match on both sides.


3A. PAIR PROGRAMMING - REMOTE SESSION

You’ll work with one of our engineers on a small technical exercise using Python and Terraform.

We’re not assessing memorised syntax or speed under pressure. We’re interested in how you reason, collaborate, use tests to guide your work, learn from documentation or tools, and communicate while solving an unfamiliar problem.


3B. TECHNICAL ONSITE

This technical stage takes place in our London office and consists of one session.

System design

You’ll walk us through a real system you’ve worked on and had meaningful influence over.

We’ll ask about the problem, constraints, operational characteristics, design decisions, trade-offs and how the system evolved over time.

This isn’t a formal presentation. You’ll introduce the system for around 10–15 minutes, then we’ll explore it together in more depth.


4. OPERATING PRINCIPLES INTERVIEW

We’ll discuss examples from your past experience that relate to how we work at Gigaton:

 - Concrete Honesty

 - Autonomous Ownership

 - Go Gig or Go Home

 - Cement It with Fun and Kindness

We’re interested in specific examples of how you’ve demonstrated these behaviours in practice rather than abstract culture-fit questions.


5. CEO CONVERSATION

Finally, you’ll meet Josh, our CEO.

This is a chance to talk more broadly about Gigaton, our mission, where the company is heading and whether this feels like the right move for both sides.

We believe hiring is a two-way process. Just as we’ll conduct reference checks before making a final offer, we encourage you to reference-check us too by speaking with team members you haven’t yet met.

Once interviews are complete, we’ll move quickly to a decision, and we’re always happy to provide feedback at any stage.

postings.title: Director of Deployment
postings.description:
At Gigaton, we’re on a mission to cut gigatonnes of carbon emissions from the world’s biggest emitting industries (like cement, steel and glass), by building autonomous AI control and optimisation systems that learn and leverage the physics of manufacturing. Our products run heavy industrial plants more efficiently, more stably, and with lower emissions in real time - laying the foundation for the next industrial revolution.

We are a team of scientists, engineers, builders, and operators who love hard problems, have high standards, and want to make change happen in the physical world. We care about deep tech, but we care even more about whether it delivers cost and carbon impact in a live plant, with real people, under real constraints.

With Gigaton, you’ll solve really tough problems in places few people ever get close to, and build something that actually helps the planet. Are you up for the challenge?


ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Director of Deployment to lead our Solutions team, the engineers who get our product live in industrial customers' plants, and to make every deployment faster, better and more reliable than the last.

You'll be accountable for every deployment we run, and be the senior escalation route, for our team and our customers, when something gets stuck.

This is a new role, and a leadership role, but a hands-on one. You'll coach our solutions engineers and leaders as they own deployments and customer relationships themselves, and step in yourself when a plant needs it. You'll work with Product, Machine Learning and Engineering to decide what goes back into the core product, so every plant is faster than the last.


WHAT WILL THIS ROLE ACHIEVE?

The goal: Take Gigaton from 9 plants live to 50 by the end of 2027, with every new plant going from signed contract to the end of evaluation in 8 weeks.

Outcome – 50 plants live. You've taken us from 9 plants to 50 by 31 December 2027, across our customers worldwide. You've planned how many engineers we need and which teams new joiners go into, tracked the health of the whole portfolio every week, and stepped in early when a deployment started to drift.

Outcome – 8 weeks from contract to results. Today a plant takes about six months to reach evaluation. You've cut that to 8 weeks end to end, and published the numbers that prove it. You've done it by turning repeated human work and customer-specific work into product, built with Product and Engineering. Each plant now needs half the people it did when you joined.

Outcome – a grip on results. Before we start, every plant has agreed with us what success looks like and whose data counts. You've balanced the need to hit our timelines with the need to pass evaluations, pausing a plant that isn't ready rather than letting it fail, so every evaluation has passed first time. When something has gone wrong, you've found the root cause fast and fixed it, so we only make each mistake once.

Outcome – a team of superstars that keeps growing. You've designed the team that delivers 50 plants and grown it to the size your design needs, hiring people who raise our bar. You've coached it actively: your leaders run high-performing teams, every engineer is autonomous, happy and smashing it for our customers, and everyone in Solutions can name what they've got better at because of you. We haven't lost anyone we wanted to keep.

Outcome – customers who trust us at every level. Every plant has a clear owner, and an escalation route that solves problems before they reach our exec team. You've built a clean handover from Sales and a voice for Deployment in which plants we take on.

Outcome – post-sales solved. With our sales leader, you've set up how we run every plant after evaluation, and it works, with clear responsibilities mapped out. Model upkeep, support and retraining are handled. Expansion contracts and upsells run through the same model: each one has a clear owner, and we spot opportunities before the customer raises them.


WHAT A GREAT FIT LOOKS LIKE

 - You have deployed early AI product into business customers, hands-on and alongside engineers. You worked out what would create value and decided what was worth building. Not onboarding customers onto a product that was already finished.

 - You have turned bespoke work into repeatable product. You decided which customer-specific features and fixes belonged in the core product, and you can show the numbers: deployments that got faster, with fewer people, while volume grew.

 - You have earned the trust of customer leaders, from site head up to executive level, been their escalation point and unblocked hard problems. You're credible because you've built and shipped.

 - You have grown a delivery team and made the decisions that came with it, including hiring and performance management. You've designed the team's structure as it grew.

 - You're a coach who was recently a quarterback. You can still step in, but you know you'll have more impact by building a team that doesn't need you to.

 - You agree what success means with a customer before you start, and you prove it with numbers.

 - You notice early signs of trouble and raise them with urgency, and you use judgement to tell what needs action and what doesn't.

 - You're happy to travel to our plants worldwide, about a quarter of the time and more in your first few months: to build relationships with customer leaders, coach your team on site and learn how our plants run.


YOU'LL EXCEL IF

 - You have managed managers, or grown an engineer into a team lead.

 - You have worked in a forward-deployed or deployment strategist model, where small teams embed with customers.

 - You have set up post-sales or account management for a B2B product.

 - You have deployed software into physical operations: plants, factories, utilities, energy assets or similar.

 - You care about decarbonising energy intensive industries.


DETAILS

 - Reports to: Noah Miller, COO

 - Team: our Solutions team of solutions engineers and two team leads, which you'll lead and grow

 - Location: London, at least 2 days a week in the office, with about 25% travel to customer plants

 - Visa sponsorship: available if required

💡 You are not expected to check every box, and we’d love to hear from you even if your experience isn’t an exact match.

We’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change. Our people come from different countries, cultures and experiences, and we think that’s one of our biggest strengths.

We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels safe, respected and celebrated. No matter your background, if you’re excited by what we do, we want to hear from you.


THE INTERVIEW PROCESS - SUBJECT TO CHANGE

We aim to go from first call to offer in three weeks.

 1. First call with our Talent team (30 minutes)

 2. Interview with Noah, our COO, walking through your career (60 minutes)

 3. Work sample day. We share real data from one of our plants. You spend 30 minutes with two of our team leads, then present how you'd run the deployment and how you'd shape the team for 50 plants. This includes a conversation about how you lead people. We'll give you the background you need beforehand.

 4. Operating Principles interview with a panel from across Gigaton

 5. Final interview with Josh, our CEO

 6. References, then an offer

We believe hiring is a two-way process. Just as we’ll reference-check candidates before making a final offer, we encourage you to reference-check us by chatting to team members you haven’t yet met. Ask anything. We’ll answer with Concrete Honesty.
